items.title: Assess and Migrate Storage to the Cloud with AWS Transform
items.summary: Storage is a crucial component of every enterprise application, and it has the potential to be the most complex part of any cloud migration. Many migration approaches work around that complexity by starting with compute and network, leaving storage as an afterthought — and this can lead to storage becoming a late-stage bottleneck.
